product_overview: TechGadget Store is a PHP/MySQL e-commerce web application for browsing and buying gadgets, including a customer storefront and an admin dashboard for managing products, orders, users, and settings.
core_goals: Provide a fast, mobile-friendly shopping experience from discovery to order confirmation
Support secure user authentication, session-based cart (guest + logged-in) and reliable checkout with common local payment methods (COD, bKash, Nagad)
Enable admins to manage products, orders, users, coupons and site settings from a centralized dashboard
Maintain secure, maintainable PHP/MySQL code (PDO prepared statements, hashed passwords)

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Signup, login, logout, password reset and session management for customers and admins.
user_flows: POST /pages/signup.php with {name,email,password} -> Receive 201 Created with user_id and session cookie -> GET /pages/profile.php with session cookie -> Receive 200 with user profile JSON
POST /pages/login.php with {email,password} -> Receive 200 OK with session cookie -> GET /pages/dashboard.php with session cookie -> Receive 200 with dashboard HTML

POST /pages/login.php with {email,wrong_password} -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with error "Invalid credentials" -> GET /pages/dashboard.php without session cookie -> Receive 302 Redirect to /pages/login.php
POST /pages/signup.php with {name,existing_email,password} -> Receive 409 Conflict with error "Email already registered"

features.name: Product Management & Catalog
features.description: Public product listing, search, filters, pagination and product detail pages with specs and reviews.
user_flows: GET /api/products/get_products.php?page=1&limit=20 -> Receive 200 with paginated products array and metadata
GET /api/products/get_products.php?category=phones&sort=price_asc -> Receive 200 with filtered product list
GET /pages/product-detail.php?slug=example-product-slug -> Receive 200 with product HTML containing details, image gallery and reviews
GET /api/products/get_products.php?page=-1 -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation error for page parameter
GET /pages/product-detail.php?slug=non-existent-slug -> Receive 404 Not Found with error "Product not found"

features.name: Cart and Checkout
features.description: Session-based cart for guests and logged-in users (merge on login), update/remove items, and process checkout into orders.
user_flows: POST /api/cart/add.php with {product_id,quantity} and session cookie -> Receive 200 with updated cart summary (items, subtotal)
POST /api/cart/update.php with {cart_item_id,quantity} and session cookie -> Receive 200 with updated cart totals
POST /api/checkout/process.php with {payment_method,shipping_address,coupon_code?} and session cookie -> Receive 201 Created with order_id and status 'pending'
POST /api/cart/add.php with {product_id,quantity} where product is out-of-stock -> Receive 409 Conflict with error "Out of stock"
POST /api/checkout/process.php with {payment_method} missing required shipping_address -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors

features.name: Wishlist & Reviews
features.description: Allow logged-in users to toggle wishlist items and submit product reviews with rating and title; reviews appear on product detail pages.
user_flows: POST /api/users/wishlist with {product_id} and session cookie -> Receive 200 OK with updated wishlist status
GET /pages/dashboard.php with session cookie -> Receive 200 with wishlist items visible in dashboard
POST /api/users/wishlist with {product_id:invalid} and session cookie -> Receive 404 Not Found with error "Product not found"
POST /api/reviews/submit with {product_id,rating,title,comment} and session cookie -> Receive 201 Created with review_id
POST /api/reviews/submit with {product_id,rating:6,title,comment} and session cookie -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation error "Rating must be between 1 and 5"

features.name: Coupons & Discounts
features.description: Apply coupon codes during checkout to modify totals; admin can create and manage coupons from the admin panel.
user_flows: POST /api/coupons/apply with {code} and session cookie -> Receive 200 OK with discount details and adjusted cart total
POST /api/coupons/apply with {code:expired} and session cookie -> Receive 410 Gone with error "Coupon expired"
POST /api/coupons/apply with {code:invalid} and session cookie -> Receive 404 Not Found with error "Coupon not found"

features.name: Orders & Order Tracking
features.description: Order creation at checkout, user order history and order status tracking (pending → delivered).
user_flows: GET /pages/orders.php with session cookie -> Receive 200 OK with list of user's orders
GET /api/orders/status?order_id=123 with session cookie -> Receive 200 OK with order status payload {order_id,status,history}
GET /api/orders/status?order_id=99999 with session cookie (order not owned by user) -> Receive 403 Forbidden with error "Access denied"
GET /pages/order-detail.php?id=123 with session cookie -> Receive 200 OK with order items and tracking timeline

features.name: Admin Dashboard & Management
features.description: Admin-only interfaces to manage products, orders, users, coupons and site settings; protected by admin authentication and role-based sessions.
user_flows: POST /admin/login.php with {email,password} -> Receive 200 OK with admin session cookie
GET /admin/products.php with admin session cookie -> Receive 200 OK with product management UI and product list
GET /admin/orders.php with admin session cookie -> Receive 200 OK with order management UI
GET /admin/products.php without admin session cookie -> Receive 302 Redirect to /admin/login.php (or 401 Unauthorized)
POST /admin/login.php with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with error "Invalid admin credentials"
